display_long_description:
Welcome to Blendimals!

Step into a magical forest and use your controllers to mix cute animals with everyday objects — and discover what adorable hybrid creatures appear!

How to Play:
Pick up an animal, mix it with an object, and see which unique hybrid creature is revealed. Simple to learn, endlessly surprising!

Features:

Unique hybrid creatures to discover
Beautiful VR forest environment with a stunning night sky
Designed for kids — simple, intuitive, and safe
No ads — just pure fun
Supports Meta Quest controllers

🦕 Dino Pack — Available Now!
Replace all animals with dinosaurs! T-Rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, Pterodactyl, and Brontosaurus are waiting. Mix them with objects and discover 20 incredible dino hybrids. Available for $0.99 in the game.

Perfect for the Whole Family
Blendimals is designed for children but enjoyed by the whole family. Simple enough for the youngest players, surprising enough to delight everyone.

A World Full of Surprises
Every combination reveals a new creature. What happens when you mix a T-Rex with a robot? Or a Pterodactyl with ice cream? Jump in and find out!
